name: 独立双样本 t 检验计算器

map.两独立组均值比较，假定方差齐性。: Comparing the means of two independent groups, assuming equal variances.
map.📖 查看「独立双样本 t 检验计算器使用指南」: 📖 View the "Independent Two-Sample t-Test Calculator User Guide"
map.独立双样本 t 统计量用两组均值之差除以合并标准误，衡量两组总体均值是否有显著差: The independent two-sample t statistic divides the difference between the two group means by the pooled standard error to test whether the population means differ significantly. The pooled variance s_p² is the weighted average of the two variances by sample size, with df = n₁ + n₂ − 2. The larger |t| is, the stronger the evidence against the null hypothesis of equal group means.
map.要求两组方差齐。: The two groups must have equal variances.
map.方差不齐应 Welch 校正。: Unequal variances call for the Welch correction.
map.两独立组均值差异：t=(m1−m2)/√(sp²(1/n1+1/n2))。: Difference between two independent group means: t=(m1−m2)/√(sp²(1/n1+1/n2)).
map.df=n1+n2−2，判断差异是否显著。: df=n1+n2−2 decides whether the difference is significant.
map.方差齐性假设（不齐用 Welch）。: Assumes homogeneity of variance (otherwise use Welch).
map.m1=85、m2=80、sp=10、n1=n2=30：t=5/√(100×(2/: m1=85, m2=80, sp=10, n1=n2=30: t=5/√(100×(2/30))=5/√6.667=5/2.582≈1.936, df=58. Significance requires |t| above the critical value of 2.00, so this case is borderline.
map.方差不齐怎么办？: What if the variances are unequal?
map.用 Welch t 检验（df 经 Welch-Satterthwaite 校正: Use Welch's t-test (with the Welch-Satterthwaite df correction), which is more robust and the default in most software.
map.t 与 z 检验区别？: How do t-tests and z-tests differ?
map.σ 未知用小样本 t（用 s、t 分布）；σ 已知或大样本用 z。: Use the t-test for small samples when σ is unknown (relying on s and the t distribution); use z when σ is known or the sample is large.
map.独立样本 t 检验（合并方差）：s_p² = [(n₁−1)s₁² + (n₂−: Independent-samples t test (pooled variance): s_p² = [(n₁−1)s₁² + (n₂−1)s₂²] ÷ (n₁+n₂−2); t = (m₁−m₂) ÷ √(s_p²×(1÷n₁ + 1÷n₂)); df = n₁+n₂−2; the two-sided p is evaluated exactly with the incomplete beta function betai(df/2, 0.5, df ÷ (df+t²)). Validation: six non-empty guards; the hint card additionally requires n≥2 and s>0. Criteria (hint card): a standard-deviation ratio >2 suggests Welch correction (Welch t and dfw are provided); n<15 flags a small sample; the effect size Cohen d = (m₁−m₂) ÷ s_p is given.
